real_audio_v1.description: Authentic human microphone recordings spoken by a human user covering CRM, support, analytics, and out-of-domain knowledge queries.

benchmark_audio_v1.description: Standardized benchmark voice recordings covering 8 database and distractor prompts across 4 levels of formant-preserving obfuscation.

semantic_conflict_v1.description: Semantic-conflict challenge dataset containing 5 paired cases (10 total): positive vs. negated, command vs. mention, operational vs. hypothetical, explicit vs. ambiguous, and uncorrected vs. cancelled intent.

semantic_conflict_audio_v1.description: Phase 6.1 paired audio evaluation corpus covering 5 semantic-conflict pairs (10 speech files): negation, mention-vs-command, hypothetical queries, underspecified/ambiguous requests, and trailing cancellations.

required_diversity_criteria: Minimum 5 distinct speaker pseudonyms across balanced genders and accents
Acoustic noise variants: 20dB SNR and 10dB SNR room background noise
Semantic distractors mentioning database entities without operational verbs (min 20 cases)
Linguistic variations: negations, paraphrases, and boundary constraints (min 20 cases)
Ambiguous and underspecified requests requiring abstention or clarification (min 15 cases)
